_about: Source registry. One record per source consulted for the NEET-PG 2027 evidence analysis. Retrieved = date the page was read in this project. No source file is retained (storage_permitted=false), so no checksums are recorded; only facts and short paraphrases are kept. 'automated_retrieval' records how the page was read, not a permission: terms of use were not reviewed unless stated.

sources.name: NBEMS NEET-PG 2026 Information Bulletin v2.1
sources.publisher: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences
sources.automated_retrieval: read once via a web-scraping tool from a third-party mirror (Testbook CDN); the official site copy was not compared
sources.licence: Government notice; reuse terms not stated
sources.confidence: high (content); medium (mirror, not the official URL)
sources.notes: Gives pattern (180 MCQs, 5 x 36, 42 min per section, locked sections) and marking (+4/-1/0). Contains no questions.

sources.name: MedExamsPrep: NEET PG 2025 Paper Analysis
sources.licence: All rights reserved (assumed); facts only recorded
sources.notes: Claims recall of all 200 questions but publishes only a subject table and a topic list, not the questions. Its subject table totals 195 of 200 and has no Psychiatry row (folded into Medicine). Also claims ~50% image-based, ~70% clinical vignettes, ~30% repeats. Single source; not independently confirmed. The page promotes the publisher's own books.

sources.name: PrepLadder: Most Expected Topics for NEET PG 2026
sources.notes: States it examined 600+ questions from 2023-2025. Claims ~30% repeats and 18-25% image questions in 2025. Topic lists are expectations; they are NOT used as historical observations here.

sources.name: Fornix Academy: NEET PG 2026 Exam Analysis
sources.confidence: medium for pattern facts; low for question-type claims
sources.notes: Explicitly declines to give subject counts because NBEMS publishes none. Reports very few image questions and no video questions (candidate reports). Gives appeared count 2,65,980 and Jaipur re-exam for 2,445 candidates (cites PIB).

sources.name: PrepLadder: NEET PG 2026 Detailed Exam Analysis (candidate survey)
sources.notes: Reports perceived weightage by % of respondents (sample size not stated; ~129-133 implied by percentages). No question counts. 75.9% of respondents called clinical questions dominant; 10.5% named image-based; video negligible. Repeat estimates varied from 0 to 70+.

sources.name: DBMCI: NEET PG 2024 Exam Analysis & Recall
sources.notes: Subject table sums to 200 but pairs are implausible (ENT 30, 'Surgery incl. Ortho/Anaes/Radio' 4, PSM 5, Paediatrics 3), so rows appear misaligned. REJECTED for subject distribution. Shift not stated.

sources.name: Cerebellum Academy: NEET PG 2024 Exam Analysis
sources.notes: Only shift timings and attendance were extractable (2,28,540 appeared). No counts or topics usable.

sources.name: CoreBTR: INI-CET May 2026 Full Recall & Exam Analysis
sources.notes: Says ~200 questions were compiled from recall. Names specific concepts (Kawasaki disease, Rett syndrome, GCS calculation, congenital hypothyroidism, Courvoisier sign, trauma primary-survey sequence, Barrett oesophagus image). Claims image questions increased; surgery ~18-20 questions.

sources.name: Cerebellum Academy: INI-CET November 2025 Exam Analysis
sources.notes: Student estimates: 70-75% clinical vignettes; pre-clinical ~20-25 Q; para-clinical ~35-40 Q; image questions focused on interpretation. No topics.

sources.name: DocTutorials: INI CET May 2025 Exam Analysis
sources.notes: Reports a few image-based questions (radiology, histopathology); surgery perceived dominant. Survey percentages are of respondents, not of questions.

sources.name: PW MedEd: FMGE June 2026 Exam Analysis
sources.notes: Claims 20+ video-based questions (clinical findings, movements, neurological signs, radiology) and more integrated questions (e.g. Medicine+Pharmacology). Conflicts with official figure reported by S12.

sources.name: The Indian Express: NMC defends video-based FMGE questions
sources.notes: NBEMS added video-based questions in June 2026 (real clinical recordings). Officials: 12-14 clips; SC petition: ~12; students: 12-28; NBEMS has not confirmed a number. Demo test included video questions. Pass rate 12.38% of 37,448.

sources.name: MedMCQA dataset (Pal et al., 2022)
sources.publisher: Pal, Umapathi, Sankarasubbu; hosted by openlifescienceai on Hugging Face
sources.exam: AIIMS-PG and NEET-PG (as described by the authors)
sources.automated_retrieval: aggregate column statistics only, via the Hugging Face datasets-server statistics API; no question text downloaded
sources.storage_permitted: aggregate statistics only (repository licence MIT; rights in the underlying questions are not established)
sources.licence: MIT (GitHub repository); dataset card says licence 'Needs More Information'
sources.notes: Authors describe validation (4,183) as NEET-PG 2001-present and test (6,150) as AIIMS-PG 1991-present, collected 'from open websites and books'. Checks here found: 31.5% of 'NEET-PG' validation is Dental and 423 of its items are labelled 'AIIMS 2017-2020'; test has 682 'Unknown' subject; topic labels are empty; similar questions were removed across splits (hides repeats). No year/session field.

sources.name: Times of India: SC notice on NEET-PG 2026 answer-key disclosure mechanism
sources.notes: NBEMS notice of 1 Oct 2026 gives candidates question IDs, numerical answer identifiers, their responses and marks in their own login; petition seeks the actual questions. Confirms question text is not released.

sources.name: Medical Dialogues: SC to examine NBE's NEET PG non-disclosure policy
sources.notes: NBEMS published the NEET PG 2025 answer key following Supreme Court orders of 29 Apr (2025) to publish raw scores and answer keys; questions themselves not disclosed.

sources.name: Shiksha: INI CET Answer Key (memory based)
sources.notes: States AIIMS does not release an official or provisional INI-CET answer key; Collegedunia says the same.

sources.name: Careers360 and Shiksha on FMGE answer key / question paper
sources.notes: Say NBEMS did not release the FMGE question paper or answer key PDF; another site (fmgeprep.com) says a key is shown in candidate logins without the paper. Conflict recorded; no question text available either way.
